criteria.name: distinctiveness
criteria.description: The character has a specific combination of traits that makes them feel like a real individual, not a generic archetype.

criteria.name: internal_consistency
criteria.description: Role, backstory, goal, and flaw are coherent — they all fit together with no contradictions.

criteria.name: dramatic_utility
criteria.description: The flaw and goal would generate interesting conflict. The character is not passive or consequence-free.
